title: EngineProtocol
description: Payloads of the JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol between the extension host and the analysis engine over stdio (Content-Length framing, UTF-8). Methods (protocol version 2): request engine/initialize (InitializeParams -> InitializeResult, must come first), request engine/ping (no params -> PingResult), request engine/shutdown (no params -> null), notification engine/exit (process exits), notification engine/setLogLevel (SetLogLevelParams), notification $/cancelRequest ({id}). Analysis requests, each listed in InitializeResult.capabilities.methods once the engine implements it: python/classAnatomy (ClassAnatomyParams), python/callGraph (CallGraphParams), python/controlFlow (ControlFlowParams) and python/moduleGraph (ModuleGraphParams) -> GraphDocument; python/indexFiles (IndexFilesParams) -> IndexResult; diff/compare (DiffCompareParams) -> ChangeSummary. The results are defined in graph-schema.json; this schema does not reference it. Analysis problems are diagnostics in the result; JSON-RPC errors only mean invalid params, cancellation or an internal error. See docs/architecture.md for error codes.

storageDirectory.description: An absolute directory owned by Hearback (the extension's global storage, engine/), created by the host; the engine keeps Jedi's cache in it.

methods.description: Request and notification names the engine handles.

sandboxed.description: True when the audit-hook sandbox (no processes, no sockets) is active.

TextPosition.title: TextPosition
TextPosition.description: Zero-based line and UTF-16 code unit offset within the line, like Position in graph-schema.json.

file.description: Absolute path of the file. The ranges in this file repeat it exactly; ranges in other workspace files repeat their paths, and ranges with a revision of a renamed file the base version's path (BaseVersion.file).

text.description: The editor's current text of a dirty document, or null when the file does not exist in the working tree (a deleted file). With null and a base, the file's own nodes, the module included, come from the base version and are deleted: ghosts whose ranges carry the base revision. Without a base it has no nodes. Without text the engine reads the file itself with its safe reader.

BaseVersion.title: BaseVersion
BaseVersion.description: The diff base of a file, read by the host from Git.

revision.description: The resolved commit SHA of the diff base.

file.description: Absolute path of the file in the base version, when it differs (a renamed file).

text.description: The file's text in the base version, or null when the file does not exist there (an added file).

FileOverlay.title: FileOverlay
FileOverlay.description: The current text of a dirty document; it takes precedence over the file on disk.

FileBase.title: FileBase
FileBase.description: The diff base of one workspace file.

file.description: Absolute path of the file in the working tree; for a deleted file, its last path.

RulesSource.title: RulesSource
RulesSource.description: The side-effect rules file of hearback.sideEffects.rulesFile.

path.description: Absolute path of the rules file, for messages.

text.description: The file's text, read by the host (at most 1 MiB).

useJedi.description: Resolution step 3 (Jedi) for obj.method() calls in python/callGraph; hearback.engine.useJedi, default true.

maxNodes.description: hearback.graph.maxNodes, default 300: the engine cuts the graph at 10 × maxNodes, at most 10,000 nodes, and sets meta.truncated.

WorkspaceRoot.title: WorkspaceRoot
WorkspaceRoot.description: The workspace folder of a single-file analysis.

root.description: Absolute path of the workspace folder: the source root for module names and imports.

WorkspaceFiles.title: WorkspaceFiles
WorkspaceFiles.description: The Python files of one workspace folder (at most 5,000).

root.description: Absolute path of the workspace folder.

files.description: Absolute paths of the folder's Python files, filtered by the host.

bases.description: The base versions of changed files, when compared.

root.description: Absolute path of the workspace folder.

files.description: Absolute paths of the files of this batch; the host sends at most 250 files or 4 MB.

CallDirection.title: CallDirection
CallDirection.description: outgoing: the callees; incoming: the callers; both.

ClassAnatomyParams.title: ClassAnatomyParams
ClassAnatomyParams.description: python/classAnatomy -> GraphDocument (view classAnatomy) of the whole file, state-matrix data included. It focuses on the class or method named by symbol, else on the one at position, else on none.

symbol.description: Id of the class or method to focus on, e.g. of a Changes tree item or a graph node; it takes precedence over position. The engine looks it up in the working text, then in the base version: a symbol that only the base has (a ghost) is analyzed in the base version, and its nodes come back deleted, with ranges that carry the base revision.

CallGraphParams.title: CallGraphParams
CallGraphParams.description: python/callGraph -> GraphDocument (view callGraph): callers and callees of the function or method named by symbol, else of the innermost one at position, over hops levels, across the workspace files. It needs position or symbol.

symbol.description: Id of the function or method, e.g. of a Changes tree item or a graph node; it takes precedence over position. The engine looks it up in the working text, then in the base version: a symbol that only the base has (a ghost) is analyzed in the base version, and its nodes come back deleted, with ranges that carry the base revision.

hops.description: How many call levels to follow (hearback.graph.defaultHops, default 2).

source.description: Requires position or symbol. Applies to every request, because source is required.

ControlFlowParams.title: ControlFlowParams
ControlFlowParams.description: python/controlFlow -> GraphDocument (view controlFlow) of the function or method named by symbol, else of the innermost one at position. It needs position or symbol.

symbol.description: Id of the function or method, e.g. of a Changes tree item or a graph node; it takes precedence over position. The engine looks it up in the working text, then in the base version: a symbol that only the base has (a ghost) is analyzed in the base version, and its nodes come back deleted, with ranges that carry the base revision.

source.description: Requires position or symbol. Applies to every request, because source is required.

ModuleGraphParams.title: ModuleGraphParams
ModuleGraphParams.description: python/moduleGraph -> GraphDocument (view moduleGraph): the import dependencies of the workspace folder.

scopes.description: Absolute paths of the folders selected in the Explorer; without them the whole workspace folder.

focusFile.description: Absolute path of the file whose module the graph focuses on.

IndexFilesParams.title: IndexFilesParams
IndexFilesParams.description: python/indexFiles -> IndexResult: fills the engine's per-file summaries for one batch.

DiffCompareParams.title: DiffCompareParams
DiffCompareParams.description: diff/compare -> ChangeSummary: the change status of every symbol against the base and the line hunks; without a base, the outline of the file.

EngineErrorData.title: EngineErrorData
EngineErrorData.description: The data member of JSON-RPC error responses sent by the engine.

kind.description: Machine-readable error kind, e.g. not-initialized, shutting-down, invalid-params, internal.

FatalStartupError.title: FatalStartupError
FatalStartupError.description: Written by engine/run_engine.py as one stderr line 'HEARBACK_ENGINE_FATAL <json>' before exiting with code 3 (python-too-old) or 4 (bootstrap-failed).
